declarations.description:
A floating bar for what to do with the current selection: "3 selected", the bulk actions, and a button that clears
the selection. Place it after the collection it acts on (a `c2-table`, a `c2-list`, a grid of cards), inside the same
scroll container: it sticks to the bottom of that container and floats over the content, taking no room in the
layout. Leave some bottom padding on the collection so the bar never covers its last row.

The app owns the selection. Set `count` from it: the bar shows while `count` is above zero and slides away at zero.
The clear button and Escape fire `clear`; empty the selection there, which sets `count` back to 0. Escape that a
popup inside the bar uses (an open `c2-select` or menu) does not clear: the bar skips an Escape inside an open
popover or one whose `keydown` was `preventDefault()`ed. The count is announced to screen readers ("3 selected") as
it changes, in the built-in wording even when the `label` slot replaces the visible text. Hiding the bar takes its actions out
of the Tab order, so an action that empties the selection should move focus back to the collection.

Put the actions in the default slot: `c2-button`s, a `c2-button-group toolbar` for one Tab stop with arrow keys,
or a menu of further actions. The actions stay on one line. Where the bar is 480px wide or less (a phone), the count
and the clear button share the top row and the actions take a full-width row below; actions that still do not fit
scroll sideways, and the edge with more actions past it fades.
declarations.name: ActionBar

cssProperties.description: `sticky` follows the bottom of the scroll container; `fixed` pins the bar to the viewport.
cssProperties.name: --c2-action-bar--position

cssProperties.description: Space between the count, the divider, the actions and the clear button.
cssProperties.name: --c2-action-bar__container--gap

cssProperties.description: Past this width the actions scroll sideways (or wrap, with `--c2-action-bar__actions--flex-wrap: wrap`).
cssProperties.name: --c2-action-bar__container--max-width

cssProperties.description: How far the bar slides as it shows and hides.
cssProperties.name: --c2-action-bar__container--offset

cssProperties.description: The rule between the count and the actions; `none` removes it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-action-bar__divider--border-left

cssProperties.description: `nowrap` keeps the actions on one line, scrolling sideways when the bar is narrower than they are; `wrap` stacks them onto further lines instead.
cssProperties.name: --c2-action-bar__actions--flex-wrap

cssProperties.description: How far the fade reaches in from an edge that has more actions scrolled past it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-action-bar__actions__fade--size

slots.description: Replaces the "N selected" text, for example to name what is selected ("3 orders selected").
slots.name: label

members.name: count
members.description: How many items are selected. The bar shows while it is above zero.

members.name: shownCount
members.description:
The count the label shows. It keeps the last non-zero count while the bar fades out, so the label does not read
"0 selected" on the way out, and so the live region has nothing new to announce.

members.name: overflow
members.description: Which ends of the actions have more actions scrolled past them; that end fades.

members.name: wasOpen
members.description: Whether the bar was open at the last update: it slides only when that changes, never on the first render.

members.name: clear
members.description: Fires `clear`, as the clear button and Escape do.

members.name: observeActions
members.description: Watches the actions box and every action in it, so the fades follow a resize or an action changing width.

members.name: slide
members.description:
Slides the bar up into place as it shows, and down as it hides, while it fades (a CSS transition). An animation
rather than a transition, so the closed bar rests in place: only while it moves does it reach below its spot.

events.name: clear
events.description: The clear button was activated or Escape was pressed in the bar. Empty the selection in response; the bar does not change `count` itself. Does not bubble.

attributes.name: count
attributes.description: How many items are selected. The bar shows while it is above zero.
